verdict.rationale: Recruitee offers a separate Careers API token type, created via '+Add token > Careers API token'. Its docs say it only covers the /offers, /offers/:id and /offers/:offer_slug/candidates endpoints, so it is a first-party, restricted-scope credential. This is a coarse, fixed scope tied to careers-site use, not configurable least-privilege scoping of the main API's bearer tokens. Missing for 10: granular per-resource or per-action scopes on the main API token, read-only vs write permission selection, token expiry or rotation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: The token only covers the endpoints mentioned in the documentation: /offers /offers/:id /offers/:offer_slug/candidates
Click on +Add token > Careers API token and provide the API Token label.
